design.act: test the fish-sign family of Asset F sign by sign for coastal enrichment in the pinned CISI-based corpus layer of record, against that layer's corpus-wide coastal share, under lists frozen at step 0 before any counting; build Asset F at the same step 0 as the shared fish-family list Spec 048 (design D-04) consumes by digest

claim.state: SETTLED, partially falsified on the family-level coastal test; that verdict is not re-opened, re-run, or re-adjudicated by this spec
claim.residue: the claim record's not-understood text: the family was treated together and the site types were the CISI-published types; the sign-by-sign test with better site classifications has not been run

layer_of_record.posture: a downloads-tree file held by the program and read by the Phase-45/46/54 scripts of record; not a repository file on main; no bulk copy is committed by this freeze; gate 0.1 re-asserts this pin at step 0 before any counting

reproduction.unclassed_site: Surkotada (61 inscriptions), unclassed in the original script

asset_f.source: Parpola, Asko. 1994. Deciphering the Indus Script. Cambridge: CUP - the published sign list (fig. 5.1, pp. 70-78), as cited in the program's Mahadevan-Parpola crosswalk
asset_f.membership: DD-044-5, confirmed at freeze: Parpola's published list governs membership (inclusion_basis parpola-list-fish or parpola-list-fish-variant only); Mahadevan and Parpola numbers are locators, never membership criteria; the 72/64/70 trio and the Phase-43 six are a reported cross-check in the step-0 record
asset_f.form: a single canonical JSON file asset-f-fish-family.json built at step 0 (UTF-8, keys sorted, members sorted by sign_key), each member carrying sign_key, mahadevan_number, parpola_number, depiction_note, source_citation, source_locator, inclusion_basis, contested, and notes
asset_f.digest_rule: the asset's identity is the SHA-256 of its canonical file with the digest field itself excluded; frozen before any coastal count exists; never edited in place after freezing - a corrected list is a new asset version with a new digest, usable only under a new freeze
asset_f.consumer: Spec 048 (design D-04) consumes Asset F by digest and does not re-derive it; the draft's Spec 045 consumer name was corrected at the freeze (adjudication.md section 7.1)

coastal_list.rule: frozen at gate 0.3 from the Spec 027 Stage 0 gazetteer and published site geography: a site is coastal/maritime if its published location is a port or within the coastal zone
coastal_list.contested: every site whose coastal status is contested in the literature is listed as contested in the frozen list; no site is classed by its fish counts

test.unit: the sign token on both sides of the comparison (DD-044-2); the inscription-level version is a stated sensitivity, never the primary
test.measure: per Asset F member: coastal tokens, inland tokens, total, coastal share, against the corpus-wide coastal share (base rate, gate 0.5)
test.exact_test: Fisher's exact test, one-sided in the enrichment direction, per sign on the 2x2 table (member tokens x coastal/inland against all other tokens x coastal/inland)
test.correction: Bonferroni family-wise correction across the members tested, at the 5% family level (DD-044-4)
test.criterion: ENRICHED iff the corrected exact-test result is below 0.05 and the coastal share ratio (member coastal share over corpus coastal share) is at least 1.5; both clauses required
test.too_thin: members below 30 total occurrences are recorded TOO THIN per member; fewer than two members clearing the floor closes the execution as TOO THIN with the full census as its finding

design.fences: the Roif hold binds every output (records internal; campaign reporting names this member only as executed - held under the Roif gate, without result content); an ENRICHED member does not change, soften, or re-open the family-level verdict (partially falsified); no outcome establishes what any fish sign meant; sign identities and site classifications are compilation-relative to the pinned layer and the frozen lists
design.execution_gate: Execution is Phase-404 under this frozen contract, on a separate owner execution order, and awaits the verified approval of this spec's OSF contract registration (OPEN-044-5; osf-spec-registration.md); no count was made at the freeze itself, Asset F has not been built, and no coastal list has been enumerated beyond the two sites the record itself names

crosswalk.citation: Parpola, Asko. 1994b. Sign list (= Parpola 1994a fig. 5.1, pp. 70-78)

anchors.posture: asserted at the freeze from a fresh recompute; this spec moves no anchor; the file is asserted byte-identical before and after any execution
